# Profession trainers / Berufslehrer

`Trainers.lua` is generated by `tools/import_trainers.py` from two pinned inputs (commits and SHA-256 in `SOURCES.json`).

**Since 0.29 the file holds only the NPC id, the profession and the highest rank taught** (from CMaNGOS). Name, position, faction and title are read at runtime from the **QuestieDB addon**, which CraftPilot declares as a required dependency (`## Dependencies: QuestieDB`; CurseForge installs it automatically). No QuestieDB data is redistributed with CraftPilot. At import, QuestieDB is only used to check which NPCs are trainers in Forever.

- **QuestieDB** (https://github.com/Questie/QuestieDB), Forever data: which NPCs carry the trainer flag, their sub name, faction and position (`data/Forever/foreverNpcDB.lua`), and the Forever area-to-UiMap table (`support/Forever/Zones/areaIdToUiMapId.lua`). QuestieDB's Forever coordinates were converted from Classic Era with Forever map bounds; NPCs that are new in Forever or moved may be missing.
- **CMaNGOS classic-db** (https://github.com/cmangos/classic-db, GPL-3.0), `npc_trainer` and `npc_trainer_template`: which rank lessons (Apprentice, Journeyman, Expert, Artisan) each trainer teaches. This is Classic 1.12 data, not a Forever record.

Bundled: NPC id, profession, rank cap. No names, positions, quests, items, drops or other NPCs.

**Licensing.** CraftPilot is GPL-3.0-only. CMaNGOS classic-db is GPL-3.0; its COPYRIGHT.md notes that World of Warcraft content remains Blizzard's. QuestieDB states that its data, imported from Questie, historically had no explicit license ("when in doubt, all rights reserved"). That is why CraftPilot reads it from the separately installed QuestieDB addon instead of bundling it. Without a readable QuestieDB the hand-kept list in `Data.lua` is used.

**Hand-kept additions.** `Data.lua` adds trainers missing here (Forever-only herbalism starters, Annora's Uldaman entrance pin). An entry with the same profession and name is replaced by the generated one.

**Validation at import (QuestieDB v1.1.2, classic-db e4825cf):** 228 entries for all twelve professions. Of 62 previously hand-kept trainers found in both, 54 agree within two map percent and in rank. Seven Stormwind trainers moved about 14 map percent; the generated positions match the current Stormwind map (for example Cordell's Enchanting at 53.0/74.2), the old values matched the original Classic map. Bena Winterhoof teaches Apprentice only according to CMaNGOS (was 150).
